reason: `lru_set` breaks out of its eviction loop when no non-pinned victim exists and then unconditionally inserts the new key. It therefore fails to enforce capacity when all cached keys are pinned (and at zero capacity). Add defined behavior for these cases that does not exceed capacity, with tests.
target_issue: Req 1: enforce capacity when there is no evictable key, including all-pinned and zero-capacity cases
